chunks.text: My head’s been spinning with travel stuff… I’m probably going to be in Beijing soon and it’d be nice to have a decent hotel lined up, even if I haven’t picked one yet.
And then Shanghai is on the list too—if I end up with a free day there, I kinda want to wander around and do a couple attractions instead of just work things.
Also debating taking the train between cities… like Beijing to Shanghai sounds way less stressful than dealing with airports.
If that Holiday Inn Express option is still available, yeah—go ahead and lock it in for Zhao Min, check-in 2026-03-23, for 3 nights.
For Shanghai, Yu Garden keeps coming up—honestly sounds perfect. Let’s just reserve it: April 5, 2026 in the afternoon, for Ethan Thomas, 5 tickets.
Okay, and if that train D321 is a reasonable time, just book it—May 3, 2026, Second Class, passenger name Tang Xue.
Whew. That actually makes me feel a lot better—now I can stop obsessing over logistics and just focus on the trip.
